quest.title: Shine On, Pipilpan Idol!
quest.description: Word has it that the Easybreeze Holiday Resort is hosting a Pipilpan Idol Competition...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.text: "B—Bear the miracle of the blooming Guiztli, and let the Sacred Flame ignite your smile!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah! Monsters!
"In the name of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, I present to you a dance of welcome! Shine on, Pipilpan Idol!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's coming at us! {NICKNAME}, help!
Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It just fell down on its own... Hey, funny-looking person! Umm... Are you okay? Does it hurt anywhere...?
F—Failed again... I just can't get this dance right. It's so embarrassing... Ugh... I want to crawl into a hole and die...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... So that was a dance just now? Why not try again? Maybe second time's the charm!
No, no, no! I can't do it... I'm just not cut out to be a Pipilpan Idol...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon has no idea what it's talking about anymore... Huh? Wait, what's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... "Pipilpan Idol Competition Brochure"? So this is about a competition, huh?
Oh, umm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! You're not feeling confident about the odds, so you came to us for advice, right?
I—I can't even dance properly in front of you... And my dad says I'm no good either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your dad?
Yeah, my dad's a performer too — and he's my idol!
He's an amazing dancer! He's trained so many great performers... but I'm the only one he won't teach...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why not?
He said... "'Chiton,' I can't sense your determination at all! And without determination, you'll never dance well!"

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: So I made a bet with him. If I could become a Pipilpan Idol and prove myself, he'd teach me everything he knows...

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: B—But I messed up even the welcome dance. It was such a disaster... I'm such a disaster... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, don't cry! Look, you've run into us! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are super awesome adventurers. We've seen a thing or two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll definitely help you become a Pipilpan Idol — and prove yourself to your dad!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: R—Really?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And as for you, cheer up! It's time to earn your spot in the contest. Don't worry, with us around, we're gonna make sure you knock your dad's socks off!

response.speaker: "Chiton"
response.text: P—Please, I'm begging you... stop saying that line!

dialogues.speaker: Practicing Actor
dialogues.text: "Bear the miracle of the blooming Guiztli, and let the Sacred Flame ignite your smile!"

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: How many times do I have to tell you? When you shout a slogan, do it loud and proud! It's "ignite your smile," so there's got to be more passion in there! More!

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Hold that pose! Tighten your core muscles and waist — and don't lower those legs!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Umm... C—Coach...

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Huh? It's you? Good! Get up on that stage — now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That guy's super intense... Is "Chiton" really gonna be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll have to wait and see.

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Tell me, what's the most important thing for an idol to have? That's right — muscles!

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Only strong muscles can power a great performance. Only strong muscles can crush the competition!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What kind of idol are we talking about here!?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Remember this. Being an idol is war. Only the strong survive. The path to stardom is brutal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... aren't there idols who win people's hearts with their bright smiles?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Wrong! Dead wrong! That will only make idol fans weak! Muscles maketh the idol, so come on, and show me your idol power!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: C—Can I really do this...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You've got this! Just dance your heart out! {NICKNAME} and Paimon will be cheering for you!

dialogues.speaker: Host
dialogues.text: Welcome, everyone, to the grand finale of the Pipilpan Idol Competition! I'm your host for today's climactic showdown!

dialogues.speaker: Host
dialogues.text: As you've probably seen in the brochure, the final stage is a live performance battle to determine who truly deserves the title of Idol!

dialogues.speaker: Host
dialogues.text: Let's get straight into what you all came for. Contestants, to the stage! Unleash your idol power and shine your way to the top!

dialogues.speaker: Host
dialogues.text: Shine on, Pipilpan Idols! I now declare the Pipilpan Idol Competition Finals... officially underway!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: #Finally... Phew... {NICKNAME}, Paimon... I—I'm going in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! We'll be cheering for you! You've worked so hard — just do your best, and Paimon's sure everything will be just fine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank goodness it was just a regular dance. No slip-ups this time. We should be in the clear, right?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Hmph! Don't think you're through just because you finished the routine. The real climax starts now! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: G—Go where...?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: "Bear the miracle of the blooming Guiztli, and let the Sacred Flame ignite your smile! In the name of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, I present to you a dance of welcome! Shine on, Pipilpan Idol!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! That move...

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's worst fears came true... She messed up that move...

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Coach, please... Just give me one more chance...

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: You want another shot? Then speak up when you ask for one! Where's all that fire you had when you were crying just now?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Please, Coach! Just give me one more chance! I want to become the Pipilpan Idol!

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: ...Good. That's the spirit. You pass!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? That's a pass?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Of course it is! Perseverance matters way more than technique. With perseverance, one can face down any rival and stand proud on any stage!

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Perseverance. That's an idol's true spiritual muscle! You've got the basics down, and that's why you pass!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Well, Paimon's got a lot she wants to say... but hey, all's well that ends well...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse me, are you Ohuitia? We're here to...

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Oh yes, yes, that's me! Welcome, honored guests, to the Ohuitia Travel Agency!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: You've come at just the right time! Right now, we're offering a five-day, four-night couples' vacation package at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort — inclusive of full guided tours, photo shoots, plus exclusive Koholasaurus transfers — all for just 100,000 Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, wait! We're not here to ask about tour packages. Actually, we're here to take on the competition's qualification test!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Tch...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's a quick change in attitude!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Don't mind me... Anyway, tell me, young Pipilpan, what do you think is the most important thing for an idol?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Muscles!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Exactly! It's about service attitude! You've got to keep delivering top-quality service for your fans, no matter who's in front of you, even if they don't need the tour package... You've got to stay strong, and always keep that smile going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You'd better practice what you preach first!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Get a load of this tiny, floating smarty-pants... If you can point out my flaws, it means you're starting to understand the spirit of service attitude! Now, let me test you more thoroughly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... That was abrupt...

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: When it comes to serving fans as an idol, the answer from the Pipilpan Idol Committee is: A meet-and-greet!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Come on, follow me! Pipilpan, you'll play the idol, and you two will be the fans. Let's see how your service attitude holds up!

choices.text: Finally, a test that sounds normal.
Now this is more like it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can start now.

dialogues.speaker: Muscular-Looking Person
dialogues.text: Hey! You gotta pay up for your photo session! 100,000 Mora per person, so that's a total of 300,000!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Oh? Now, here comes a troublemaker, causing trouble for the fans. How will the idol handle this crisis? Let's wait and see!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Hey, is this really part of an idol's job too?

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Well, now, that's what it takes to be a true Natlan idol!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't just reply to everything with that line!

dialogues.speaker: Muscular-Looking Person
dialogues.text: Cut the chatter! Pay up or get beat up. Choice is yours, chum!

choices.text: Actually, there's a third option. I'll beat your senses back into you.
My choice is to rearrange your faces. How about that?

dialogues.speaker: Muscular-Looking Person
dialogues.text: Ow ow ow! Stop, stop! I said it was just an act, so why are you hitting me for real!?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Sorry... Your acting was just too convincing...

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: *cough* Anyway, well done! You passed! A true idol always gives one hundred percent. As long as you give it your all, how could your service attitude ever be bad?

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: In fact, I'll admit I'm moved by your performance. This is exactly what a Pipilpan Idol should be!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly, Paimon's starting to lose sight of what a Pipilpan Idol actually is...

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Alright! Now just cover the medical expenses for our actors, and you've got my official approval!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm not trying to scam you — 100,000 Mora per person, total's 300,000!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What part of that ISN'T a scam!?

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Well, now, that's what it takes to be a...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! Idols aren't supposed to be anything like that!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a long back-and-forth of sharp words, Ohuitia finally gives in, and offers to pay for the actors' medical bills. You also receive the approval you need to enter the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Welcome! Oh, you're here for the Pipilpan Idol Competition, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, right on the mark! Wow, you're sharp!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Hehe, you flatter me. But as a part-time critic, I do suppose I've got a pretty sharp eye. Now, enough pleasantries. Let's cut to the chase!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Let me see... The golden-haired adventurer scores 9 out of 10 for style points, and the little white fairy also gets a 9! Hmm... as for you, the Pipilpan... I'm sorry, but you failed.

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Chiton"! Are you okay!? Hey! Who starts with criticism like that? Even critics shouldn't be that blunt!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: A good idol's style points have to be perfect! And accessories are vital for leaving a lasting, stylish impression!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like Venti's lyre, for example...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Now Paimon gets it! Ms. Ionna really knows her stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: See? Told you I wasn't the problem. I'm a professional, it's just the people around here, strange tastes and all.

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Why does everyone think accessories have to be about combat prowess? They're meant to be pretty, not practical!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: But my dad says overly complicated accessories can hinder your movements, whether dancing or fighting. And I wanted to have a unique appearance...

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's why your stage outfit looks so weird... Definitely the adults' fault! Hmm, let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Golden-haired adventurer... You seem to have a rather normal sense of aesthetics. Come, use the decorations here and show this Pipilpan what true style is all about!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Hmm, not bad! So, my dear actor-in-training, care to share your thoughts?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Wow! The resort-themed outfit totally nails that laid-back vacation vibe of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort! And the ocean-themed one is so perfectly summery I can almost feel the sea breeze in my hair...

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: Well, that was... very straightforward. But in short, just match your outfit with the theme. "Vacation" makes you think of relaxation, "ocean" brings to mind sunshine and waves. Got it?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Got it!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: "Got it" isn't quite enough, let's test your understanding to make sure you really do. We'll start with a simple keyword... Hmm... how about "minimalist"?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: "Minimalist," huh? That just means "simple," right? When I think of simple...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! The look in "Chiton"'s eyes — it's getting intense!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: I've got it! Minimalist means simple, and the ultimate form of simplicity is... nothing! Time to strip away all the unnecessary stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh-oh... {NICKNAME}, Paimon's got a very bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Hiyah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think, Coach? No accessories, no distractions. The best way to show off a Pipilpan's performance outfit!

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: I... Umm... You... Ah, well... Forget it. Maybe that's just how Pipilpan actors are...

dialogues.speaker: Ionna
dialogues.text: ...Maybe I was the problem all along. I give up. Y—You pass...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon agrees... we understand where you're coming from...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Anyway, this means we're finally in the finals!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: The finals... Can I really do it...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure you can! We got through all those trials without breaking a sweat, didn't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Plus, after everything we've been through, you're way stronger than when we started. Paimon's sure you've got what it takes to be a true Pipilpan Idol. Right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: "Chiton"
response.text: Haha... Yeah, you're right! Let's go, people! It's time to take on the finals!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be like that! Have some faith in her!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Although "Chiton" performs brilliantly on stage, she is unable to match the other contestants. Regrettably, she fails to clinch the championship title...

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Ugh... I—I didn't even make it to the top three...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, don't be sad! We still made it to the finals, didn't we?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Hmph... I told you, didn't I? Being an idol isn't all about glitz and glamour. The only thing that truly shines on stage is sweat. Your fundamentals are still way too weak!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That voice...?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Still, I'll give you this. You took the first step, and that's no small feat. You even made it through two rounds, way more than I expected.

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Dad...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hold up, this guy's your dad!?

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Hmph. Just because you've improved a little doesn't mean you can start getting cocky. You lost because your basics are all over the place.

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Now come on — we're going back home. I'm starting your training from scratch. From now on, you are to call me "coach," not "dad," got that?

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Coach...!

dialogues.speaker: "Campa"
dialogues.text: Good. Prepare yourself. There'll be no room to beg for mercy in a war!

dialogues.speaker: "Chiton"
dialogues.text: Yes, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously... what even is an idol to you people!?

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: So, the idol photo op, as its name suggests, is when the Pipilpan idols pose with their fans for sweet keepsake snapshots.

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: All you have to do is strike a pose and be ready for a photo. Easy enough, right? Shall we give it a go, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not quite ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: It's okay, take your time.
